content_of_post_to_answer: If you are reincarnated, do you have the same mental health issues and mind?
answer: If reincarnation exists, it may not mean carrying over the same personality or diagnoses like a saved file. A more interesting possibility is that what continues is a pattern: unfinished tendencies, fears, attachments, or ways of responding. Mental health struggles are shaped by both inner disposition and life circumstances, so a new life might express the same underlying themes in a completely different form. The deeper question may not be “Would I have the same problems?” but “What patterns would I keep recreating until I understand them?”
